texts.zh: 我们之前用[This.ContactCountry.GetName]指称的不规则物体可能是一种有机生物，[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]仍在努力验证这一假说。尽管它看起来就是一些随机的星际物质组成的团簇，但毋庸置疑地它们可以在虚空中推进，并展现出了一定程度的自主智能。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]为这种现象困惑，并正在努力验证获得的数据。
texts.en: [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is still working to confirm the hypothesis that the irregularity we had designated as [This.ContactCountry.GetName] is in fact a living organism. While it seems to be made up of a cluster of random star dust, it is demonstrably able to propel itself across the void and shows basic signs of independent agency. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] are perplexed by the phenomenon, and are working hard to verify our readings.
